assets.title: Import your CSV into Loops
assets.content:
Subject: Import your CSV into Loops
Preview text: Map your columns to contacts in the same upload

Import your CSV to create usable contacts

Hi there,

Your subscriber list is sitting in a CSV, outside Loops, the email platform for SaaS teams. Until it's imported, those contacts can't be grouped into segments, kept current, or used to trigger a single email.

Uploading that file maps each column straight to contact properties, including any custom ones you track — and adds everyone in it to a mailing list in the same step, so the list works right away.

Every plan, including Free, lets you upload as many contacts as you want. Once they're in, those properties and that list are what you'll build segments and onboarding emails on next.

See how CSV import maps columns → https://loops.so/product-email

- Loops

reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: Loops' CSV import feature, which maps my spreadsheet columns to contact properties (including custom ones) and adds everyone to a mailing list in one upload, so I can start segmenting and sending onboarding emails.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: Profile states I just opened a Loops account and already have a CSV of subscribers. The email's entire premise - 'your subscriber list is sitting in a CSV, outside Loops... until it's imported, those contacts can't be grouped' - matches that exactly, not a generic pitch. This is the literal next action for someone in my stated position, so the premise is supported rather than assumed.
assumed_experiences: Assumes I have a CSV ready to upload (profile-supported)
Assumes I haven't imported yet and contacts are currently unusable for segments/triggers (profile-supported, consistent with 'just opened account')
Assumes I already know what 'segments' and 'contact properties' mean in Loops (email-only, not established by the profile)
reader_verdicts.problem_now: Documented importance, not a hypothetical risk - the profile puts me at the exact moment this email addresses (new account, CSV not yet imported). This is the actual next step I need to take, not a future-maybe problem.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: No real doubt about whether to do this eventually - I need contacts in Loops regardless. My hesitation is only about mechanics the email doesn't cover: what happens with duplicate emails, malformed rows, or columns that don't cleanly map to existing properties.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me whether messy or duplicate rows in my CSV get handled automatically or flagged for me to fix before the list goes live.

No alternative proposition is included: a genuinely distinct commercial bet for this exact one-action request would have to invent a different next step, which the material doesn't support.
